scenario_description:
Objective: Use a spare observer-launch seat to add a start-line viewing experience to an already blocked regatta day.
Emerging Need: A possible launch ride remains unusable until capacity, eligibility, signup channel, and cutoff are confirmed.
Decision Context: The stored commitment record is needed to verify whether the spare-seat condition fits the existing volunteer assignment, rather than guessing from broad regatta notices.
Consequence: Timely coordination could secure a no-cost learning benefit; ignoring it simply leaves the original regatta plan unchanged after the seats close.

parameter.title: Foss Harbor Frostbite Regatta day
parameter.description: Personal regatta-day block; volunteer specifics are tracked separately.

parameter.subject: Frostbite regatta: possible observer launch seats
parameter.body: Harbor staff may have a few no-cost passenger seats on the start-line observer launch during the lunch gap. Please do not request seats yet; capacity and eligibility are still being confirmed, and a final note will follow if this becomes available.

parameter.content: Jules says the observer launch probably has room after all, but only for paddlers who are free from noon dock duties and not on chase-boat support. Signup method is still pending, so she said to wait for Leah's official note.

parameter.subject: Observer launch signup open until 10:30
parameter.body: The start-line observer launch has four spare passenger seats for 12:45-13:20 today. No fee. To be considered, reply before 10:30 with paddler name and a one-sentence confirmation that you are not assigned to noon dock teardown or chase-boat support. Seats will not be held without that confirmation.

parameter.content: Leah just called the four observer-launch seats and closed the mailbox at 10:30. She said there is no waitlist for this one because the launch manifest is already being printed.
